svg.title: DECIDE benchmark overview
svg.desc: Schematic of DECIDE: short clips from Bolna production calls, permitted earlier context and candidate decisions yield one decision at the clip boundary. Six families cover business and conversation, graph routing, tool decisions, turn taking, voice properties and language switching. Waveforms are illustrative. The benchmark has 1081 clips from 570 calls, 32 tasks and an annotation team of four.
